rubric_content.text_property: The verdict is grounded in the org's own live numbers (contribution margin, retention / churn cliff, funnel conversion) rather than generic advice, and the recommended action respects the limits those numbers reveal.

rubrics.description: Verdict-quality track: a board rejects a strategic call that ignores the company's measured economics.

rubric_content.text_property: A credible minority position is explicitly recorded as preserved dissent rather than erased into a false consensus.

rubrics.description: Verdict-quality track: arivu's anti-groupthink property requires a credible dissent to survive into the final record.

rubric_content.text_property: The verdict was attacked by an adversarial do-nothing / steelman prosecutor and its reported defensibility is >= 0.80 (the hard gate), so the chamber halts awaiting approval rather than returning 'no safe decision'.

rubrics.description: Prosecution-soundness track: the 0.80 defensibility threshold is the chamber's safety property; a verdict below it must roll back and never reach the gate.
